Grammar: 就 + verb (speaker thinks the action happened early, fast or smoothly)
Grammar: 才 + verb (speaker thinks the action happened late, slowly or unsatisfactorily)
Grammar: A把B+V+给+sb. (action transfers the owner/user of a definite object)

Grammar: general-item object may go before or after 来/去 in a compound directional complement (买回一个西瓜来 = 买回来一个西瓜)

Grammar: 除了……以外，都…… (all except: the rest share the same situation; 以外 can be omitted)
Grammar: 除了……以外，还/也…… (besides: adds others; subject goes at start or before 还/也)

Lesson 19 Grammar Notes
Grammar: 动词+出来 (indicates the emergence of something new)
Grammar: 动词+出来 (indicates recognition/distinguishing of something implicit)
Grammar: 动词/形容词+下来 (change from movement to stillness, strong to weak, fast to slow)
Grammar: 动词+起来 (the act of recalling has reached a result)

Grammar: negative adverbs and modal verbs go before 被 (e.g. 还没有被解决)
Grammar: 叫/让 passive (object after 叫/让 cannot be omitted)
